name: Bashal'Aran Collapse
summary: The Bashal'Aran Collapse is a subterranean cavern system lying beneath the fractured ruins of Bashal'Aran in Darkshore. Positioned far below the surface within the Maw of the Void, it shelters ancient Highborne spirits and the lingering remnants of an empire torn apart by cataclysmic ruin.

sections.title: Sunken Splendor
sections.body: When the great Sundering tore ancient Kalimdor asunder ten thousand years ago, the grand city of Bashal'Aran was shattered and swallowed into the earth. The deepest fragment of these ruins came to rest within the subterranean chasm known as the Maw of the Void. Here, submerged stone corridors and isolated ledges echo with the quiet torment of the past. Cenarion druids, including Bielara Ivyshroud, cautiously observe this sunken cavern, bearing witness to restless Forlorn Highborne phantoms who still wander the damp stonework, hopelessly bound to the memories of their fallen kingdom.

sections.title: Shadows of the Void
sections.body: Deep within the spiraling path of the collapse stands Telarius Voidstrider, a renegade demon hunter entrenched on the cliffs above. Telarius occupies the shattered foundation performing dark, solitary rituals. Those who breach his subterranean redoubt find him clutching the Writings of the Dark Herald, ominous texts pointing to foul designs festering beneath Darkshore's fractured soil. While the Cenarion Circle maintains a tenuous watch over the subterranean pool below, the dread magics woven in the depths remain an active menace to the coast.

faq.answer: It is a subterranean subzone located beneath the Maw of the Void in Darkshore. It consists of the sunken, shattered remnants of ancient Bashal'Aran that fell deep into the earth during the Great Sundering.

faq.q: How do you leave the cavern?
faq.answer: Bielara Ivyshroud, a member of the Cenarion Circle stationed near the subterranean pool of water, assists travelers trapped in the depths by teleporting them back to the surface of Darkshore.

Telarius Voidstrider is a demon hunter perched on a rocky cliff along the spiraling cavern path. He enacts mysterious and sinister rituals amidst the ancient ruins while carrying the Writings of the Dark Herald.

faq.q: Why are there ghosts haunting the collapse?
faq.answer: The ghostly apparitions are Forlorn Highborne whose lives were abruptly ended when Bashal'Aran collapsed ten thousand years ago. Their souls remain tethered to the ruins, doomed to re-enact their final moments in the dark.

angles.text: For night elves, the collapse is a painful reminder of the Hubris of Queen Azshara's court, where the shattered remains of their ancestral home now lie buried beneath the earth.
Druids of the Cenarion Circle venture into these sunken hollows to observe the corrupted lingering spirits and assist those who stumble into the chasm.
